title: Starlink Mobile: All the news on SpaceX’s major mobile carrier ambitions
summary: SpaceX has declared that it’s going to make Starlink Mobile a “major” mobile carrier. The deal, which comes as SpaceX aims to make Starlink a “major” mobile carrier , reportedly involves the Elon Musk-owned company acquiring Boost Mobile or accessing its network.
